课程简介（中文）

该课程为针对本科二、三年级开设的发展经济学课程，该课程为上海市精品课程以及复旦大学校级荣誉课程。教学目的是要让学生首先掌握发展经济学的基本理论，然后结合中国经济的发展和改革历程以及中国创造的经济增长奇迹和减贫奇迹，理解经济发展的主要影响因素，不同的发展道路，以及不同国家的经济发展经验和教训。课程主要由章元教授主讲，章元教授的主要研究领域是中国发展道路、中国减贫实践以及中国的城乡融合。

课程简介（英文）

This course is designed to let undergraduate students understand the basic theories in Development Economics, major factors determining economic development, different strategies of economic development adopted by China and other development economies, and the experiences and lessons we can draw from China’s successful economic development, comparing with some other developing countries.

The course includes 12 chapters. Chapter 1 introduces why Economics is also a sub-branch of Science, and help students to thinking, observing, explaining economic phenomena like a scientist. Chapter 2 gives a brief introduction of the definition of economic development vs. economic growth, and the evolution of Development Economics since the World War II. Chapter 3 introduces the definition of industrialization and its role in economic development. Chapter 4 gives a brief introduction of the historic background, effects of the Strategy of Giving Priority to Heavy Industries in P.R.C. Chapter 5 and 6 includes some basic models of Dual Economy, and relates them to the hot debate of labor shortage in China since the early 21st century. Chapter 7 explains the role of agriculture in economic development and the agricultural reform in rural China from 1978 to mid-1980s. Chapter 8 introduces the characters of land tenure market in developing countries and the reform of land ownership in rural China. Chapter 9 and 10 introduces the measures of poverty and inequality, and their determinants and effect in economic development, with special focus on China’s experience. Chapter 11 introduces the characters and the incomplete of rural credit market; Chapter 12 explains the process of urbanization and labor migration in development economies.

教学目标

本课程为针对本科二、三年级开设的专业基础课，是复旦大学校级荣誉课程以及上海市精品课程。课程的教学目的是要让学生首先掌握发展经济学的基本理论，然后结合中国经济的发展和改革历程以及中国创造的经济增长奇迹和减贫奇迹，理解经济发展的主要影响因素，不同的发展道路，以及不同国家的经济发展经验和教训。

教学方式

教学内容分两个板块，第一板块为课堂教学，主要讲授发展经济学的基本概念和理论；教学过程中穿插国际比较以及图片和视频等形式，阐释发展经济学的基本概念和政策实践；第二板块为双周讨论课，主要围绕中国发展道路中的重要问题和现象介绍文献和展开课堂讨论，一方面围绕中国增长奇迹和减贫奇迹介绍前沿文献，同时进行课堂讨论，帮助学生深化和掌握所学习的发展经济学知识，并能够用这些理论去观察和解释经济现象，理解和掌握这些现象背后的因果关系。
